entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集大量讨论智能体工作流（agentic workflows）以及从反应式智能体（reactive agents）到主动式智能体（proactive agents）的转变——即从你给指令它才执行，变为接入上下文后收到触发信号就自动行动。

evidence.quote: That means that if the sales team gets a contract, it will get routed to a Legora agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: The Legora agent will start working on it in parallel.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Or you connect the entire data room to a Legora agent, and the agent automatically starts organizing that data room and produce the due diligence report.

evidence.quote: Having the agent do things without you telling it what it should do.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 智能体 (agents)
entities.how_described: 与 agent 同义复数形式，如 Legora agent 在收到合同后自动并行处理，需要升级才转给律师。

evidence.quote: Oh, one of the most interesting problems right now is this transition from reactive agents to proactive agents.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 微调 (fine-tune)
entities.how_described: 本集将不微调模型作为核心战略判断：2022-2023 年的普遍认知是你必须微调模型（如 Bloomberg 花数百万建法律模型），但 Legora 打赌模型会持续变强，不把钱花在微调上。

evidence.quote: So I think the sort of tribal knowledge when we got started was that you have to fine-tune a model, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 评估 (eval)
entities.how_described: 本集称评估新模型和评估新用例的能力是创业公司应建立的核心 IP 和超能力，有了它才能在不同场景间有效路由。他们内部请律师构建用例来跑评估。

evidence.quote: I think ultimately one of the core IPs and muscles that I encourage as many of you as possible to build is the ability to eval new models and to eval new use cases because that is the superpower that then allows you to route things effectively.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
